$Comment:
The woodcutter's kit as a gear set: the four leather pieces the Sawmill's trim work pays out (Lootables/Mmo_Woodcutters_Kit.json) plus the three hatchets as the held member, any one of which completes the kit: the Sawmiller's Hatchet (RPG_Tool_Hatchet_Sawmiller, the RPG Stations item this pack overrides under the same id), the Millwright's and Marn's. The novice cap is not a member. Members are item ids, matched without regard to case. Every tier whose minimums hold applies at once, so the tiers stack: two pieces on anywhere add a little Woodcutting luck and experience; all four armor pieces add more and put the set's look on (Woodcutters_Kit_Set, an effect dedicated to this set); all four plus a hatchet in hand add the most. Held counts the active-hand item only when it is a member that is not also worn, so the third tier needs the hatchet itself in hand. Author Held as 1 or leave it out; 0 is an error. Each tier names a Badge, the set's one tile on the buff bar: the tile shown is the badge of the highest tier that holds, so its icon and name follow the kit as it fills (the three Woodcutters_Kit_Badge_* effects, each dedicated to this set).

The stats are the set's own bonus on top of what each piece and hatchet already carries, and they ride the same channels: MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING and the two MMO_BonusXp_* channels take their PERCENT as the Amount, and Stamina is Hytale's own maximum stamina. Every entry is Additive on purpose: these channels carry a base of zero, so a Multiplicative-only entry computes nothing. Opening balance, sized so that wearing the whole set adds a modest slice on top of the kit's own stats rather than a second kit; raise or lower an Amount without touching any code. Under Parent the Bonuses list replaces whole, so restate every tier you keep. The text keys are mmoskilltree.lang's gearset.woodcutters_kit.* lines.
